projectDescription: A Go-based CLI tool and gRPC service that parses and verifies tachograph data files (DDD format) from vehicle units and driver cards, supporting 1st generation, 2nd generation, and 2nd generation v2 formats.
keyFeatures: Parse 1st generation, 2nd generation, and 2nd generation v2 tachograph files
Support for both vehicle unit (VU) and driver card data
Cryptographic signature verification using EU ERCA public key certificates
JSON output for easy downstream processing
Simplified parser (dddsimple) for quick identification extraction
Batch processing of multiple files via input-list
publicApiSurface: dddparser -vu / -card (parse full tachograph data to JSON)
dddsimple [-card] (extract identification numbers and driver names)
dddui (desktop GUI for file selection and parsing)
